propositions: Child enumeration and per-child fetch failures in _assemble_context_uncached are silently swallowed by bare except Exception, leaving children list empty without recording incompleteness.
When children list is empty, PlanContext.has_children returns False, causing container-scoped DET checks like p5_task_dag to return trivial pass instead of incompleteness signal.

plan_review_precheck and plan_review_coach call finalize_verdict through different paths: precheck has real pctx in scope, while coach reconstructs a minimal pctx without hierarchy data and must read flags from ctx.inputs.

Five finalize_verdict call sites exist (plan_review_precheck, plan_review_coach, _recover_plan_review_coach_failure, _recover_plan_review_verify_failure, _degraded_plan_review_verdict) but only the precheck path currently has access to hierarchy completion status.
drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop can revert verdicts back to PASS when a BLOCK is dropped, bypassing hierarchy-incomplete signals that should persist as INDETERMINATE.
plan-review.yaml's four plan_review_coach uses steps do not pass hierarchy_incomplete flags from precheck outputs to the coach's with block, causing coach-path threading to default to False.
